LESSON: MONEY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.2 Area (10 lessons) • area of circles • area of a sector of a cir
Topic 3.3: Money
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Money, part of Measurements 3.2 Area (10 lessons) • area of circles • area of a sector of a cir in Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: What is interest in money? 2. How do we pay for goods on hire purchase?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Money together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: as the learner gathers information about simple and compound interests offered on

deposits (principal) in different financial institutions.

• Critical thinking and Problem solving: as the learner determines Appreciation and Depreciation using step by step methods

and discuss what goods are worth investing in, or buying.

• Digital literacy: as the learner do search on online shopping platforms or other sources on different types of goods for

consumer awareness.

Values

Responsibility: as the learner makes responsible choices on shopping goods that they appreciate in value.
